''See also: [[Green Light Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Green [[Light]] is a sentient force or entity that communicates telepathically with [[Alin]]. It primarily functions as a source of emotional regulation, providing him with feelings of calm, peace, and patience. By tapping into this light, [[Alin]] is able to suppress negative impulses such as irritation or recklessness. The entity offers various forms of guidance, suggesting that he remain patient, relax, or prepare for potential danger. Visually, it is described as an acid-green flicker or a constant mesh of green lightning, and when [[Alin]] utilizes its power, his eyes transform into a bright emerald color. The Green [[Light]] appears to exist within a hierarchy or alongside other forces, as it has received approval from the [[Gold]] [[Light]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Green [[Light]] is a type of light within [[Alin]] that functions as a communicative voice capable of expressing disagreement or instructing him to relax. As a power of [[Elysia]] possessed by [[Alin]], this entity provides him with patience and the ability to ground irritation. [[Alin]] can utilize the light as a shield, layering multiple defenses or forming a dome composed of interlocking six-sided plates. While [[Alin]] has used the light to banish thoughts of vengeance, [[Simon]] has also successfully summoned a shield of Green [[Light]].}}
